layoutPrinciples: 按可用安全区、宽高比、DPI 和输入方式重排，不按平台名称写死。
不整体缩小桌面弹窗；紧凑视口改为滚动内容区、固定操作区或双栏短横屏布局。
标题、警告正文、存档摘要、错误反馈和操作按钮使用独立语义槽。
所有功能文字由 Godot Control、Container、Label、Button 和 Theme 实时绘制。
覆盖是破坏性操作，默认焦点始终落在取消；恢复可用时不抢占安全默认焦点。
状态变化复用同一外壳和槽位，不因 loading、success、rejected、error 或 disabled 改变页面主几何。

globalPrimaryReferenceNotConsumed.reason: 公共主按钮与 Theme 尚未 common-approved；本页不复制或冻结该组件。

responsiveModes.content: single column with two-column save summary
responsiveModes.actions: single row; cancel left, recovery middle when available, destructive overwrite right
responsiveModes.copy: full labels; title one line when measured width fits

responsiveModes.when: safe_width >= 760 and safe_height >= 560 and not wide_dialog and not square_dialog
responsiveModes.content: single column; save summary collapses from two columns to stacked key/value rows
responsiveModes.actions: row only when every measured action keeps its text safe rect; otherwise wrap cancel above retry/overwrite without changing font size
responsiveModes.copy: full labels; critical body wraps; no auto shrink

responsiveModes.when: safe_width >= 700 and safe_height >= 700 and aspect_ratio >= 0.85 and aspect_ratio <= 1.25
responsiveModes.content: single column with compact save rows and independently scrollable detail body
responsiveModes.actions: two-row dock; cancel remains first in focus order; overwrite stays visually separated
responsiveModes.copy: full labels unless 130-percent measurement requires registered compact labels

responsiveModes.dialog: safe-area sheet; gutter=16; top and bottom follow safe insets
responsiveModes.content: scrollable title/body/summary region above a fixed action dock
responsiveModes.actions: vertical stack; cancel, retry recovery when available, destructive overwrite last; minimum height 75 each
responsiveModes.copy: registered compact visible labels 取消/恢复/覆盖; full consequence remains in body and accessible description

responsiveModes.content: two columns; left is scrollable warning and save summary, right is fixed action stack
responsiveModes.actions: cancel, retry recovery, overwrite; same 32px action role; destructive action stays at bottom
responsiveModes.copy: compact visible labels allowed only after measured 130-percent failure; no font size drop

safeArea.rule: dialog and fixed action dock must be fully contained by viewport safe rect; scroll content must never pass under the action dock without bottom padding equal to dock height.

longCopyPolicy.title: controlled wrap to two lines; never ellipsize the destructive consequence
longCopyPolicy.body: controlled wrap; compact modes scroll the content region instead of shrinking text
longCopyPolicy.versions: stack key/value rows; long identifiers may ellipsize only when the full value is available on focus or expanded detail
longCopyPolicy.actions: measure full labels first; use registered compact labels only at compact modes; accessible action names remain full

operationStates.idle: show stable prompt and enabled actions from ViewModel
operationStates.loading: retain confirmed data; disable repeated destructive input; show progress in feedback slot
operationStates.success: retain shell until a newer full ViewModel or route confirmation arrives
operationStates.rejected: retain confirmed data and revision; show rejection in feedback slot; do not style as disconnect
operationStates.error: retain confirmed data; show error code mapping and retry only when error.retryable and action enabled
operationStates.disabled: show unavailability reason; cancel remains reachable so the player is never trapped

contrastTargets.scrimRule: scrim may reduce background competition but may not lower dialog text/background contrast below targets

integerPixelRules.fractionalSystemScale: recompute in physical pixels, snap, then derive the logical rect; do not resample a completed page bitmap

mouse: destructive button hitbox stays fixed across visual states
keyboard: Tab order is cancel, retryRestore when enabled, confirmOverwrite
Enter activates only the focused control
focus remains valid after every ViewModel refresh
gamepad: B or platform back emits cancel
directional focus never jumps behind the dialog
touch: targets are at least 48x48 logical pixels
destructive action is separated from cancel and recovery
release outside the target cancels activation
bottom action dock clears gesture and rounded-corner safe insets

blockingFacts: 公共面板、按钮、弹窗、状态图标和 Theme 尚无 common-approved revision。
覆盖、取消和重试恢复 action 尚未由正式 TownUiAdapter 冻结。
视觉 revision 生成后必须在本页面原任务等待用户判断。
